QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Blaze Break!
QuestInfo.0: You reunited with #p9401522#, who's fighting his way toward Roppongi Mall, and learned how to get there. Stay on your toes; you're in for a fierce battle.
QuestInfo.1: You've infiltrated Roppongi Mall, the enemy's headquarters. The interior is crawling with mechanical soldiers. Get past them and reach the Blaze Core!
QuestInfo.2: You finally defeated the Blaze Core. Hurry and tell Asia.
